items.text: Inert observer — a MutationObserver on the dashboard body re-syncs inert when overlays open or close (search, modals, tag cloud, page overview, omnibox, move/delete/tag popovers, inline edit) so the grid is not left stuck non-interactive after rapid open/close cycles.
Inline edit inert — entering or leaving ; inline edit calls syncDashboardInert() immediately so the bookmark grid stays blocked while you edit.
G+jump promo on hold — holding G (~300 ms) shows the first-time Got it balloon beside the grid (not only after a completed G+digit or GG jump). Reset from Tours & onboarding.
Deferred promo retry — when What's new, grid keyboard promo, or another overlay blocks the balloon, the G+jump hint retries for up to ~30 s instead of being skipped forever.
Longer chord window — while the G+jump promo is visible, the category-jump chord stays armed for ~10 s (3 s otherwise) so you can read the hint and press a digit.
Five command groups — lone : lists Bookmarks, Search & navigate, Look & layout, Smart collections, and Settings & tools (clearer overview than ten nested headers).
Recent commands — your last used : commands appear at the top of the palette when you open lone : (up to five entries).
:quicktag / :qt — opens the quick-tag popover (Shift+T) on the keyboard-selected bookmark from command mode.
Rebind conflict check — choosing a key already used by another rebindable shortcut, a fixed cheat-sheet default, or a reserved grid chord shows a localized warning before save.
Preset export / import — toolbar buttons download or upload your rebindable keyboard preset as JSON (fixed defaults stay documented on the cheat sheet).
Settings search — Ctrl+Shift+K / Cmd+Shift+K now indexes fixed keyboard sections (add bookmark, quick actions, grid navigation) and every key label on each row.

Phone-only dashboard footer — the reduced footer (Search + + Bookmark) applies only at ≤768 px width. Portrait tablets and wider touch layouts keep the full desktop toolbar (Commands, Finders, Recent, Help, tag cloud).
Touch vs phone flags — data-touch-layout still drives hover previews and discoverability skips on coarse touch; data-mobile-layout is phone-width only for dashboard chrome.
GitHub Actions CI — pushes and pull requests run locale/whats-new JSON validation (npm run validate:json) and Playwright end-to-end tests.
Playwright coverage — tests for keyboard preset export/import and conflicts, inline-edit inert sync, command palette five groups / recent commands / :quicktag, and G-hold promo.
Docs — README, MANUAL, CHANGELOG, config help, and whats-new updated for v2026.06.24.
